entities.name: Niassa Company
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Niassa Company, a political institution in Mozambique during Late Colonial Mozambique (1891–1942). Grew from Mozambique Company and Slave Trade from Mozambique. Led to the emergence of Zambezia Company and Chibalo Forced Labour System.
